title: Justinj68/OM3D_PROJECT
abstract: This C++/OpenGL project is a voxel-based 3D environment that simulates a natural landscape crafted from cubes. It utilizes Perlin noise to generate realistic terrains and caves, enhancing the immersive experience. The world is efficiently managed through a chunk system, dividing it into 32x32x32 voxel chunks to optimize rendering and memory usage.
